rules.title: Single authoritative owner per state
rules.rule: Every durable business fact MUST have one authoritative owner. Replicas, caches and read models MUST declare freshness and invalidation semantics.
rules.evidence: Source-of-truth matrix + data-flow diagram + tests for write path

rules.title: Explicit trust boundaries
rules.rule: Document browser, server, database, worker, third-party, admin and tenant trust boundaries before implementing sensitive flows.
rules.evidence: Architecture diagram with trust boundaries; threat model links

rules.title: Layered business flow
rules.rule: UI/routes MUST not contain durable business rules or direct persistence writes; use explicit use-case/service boundaries and persistence gateways.
rules.evidence: Repo map + dependency inspection + representative tests

rules.title: No architecture by page
rules.rule: Design modules around business capabilities and invariants, not only screens or routes.

rules.title: Dependency direction is intentional
rules.rule: Define allowed dependency direction. Cycles across business modules require an architecture decision or refactor.

rules.title: External systems behind gateways
rules.rule: Third-party APIs, queues, email, payment, Meta, storage and search MUST be isolated behind gateways/adapters with timeout, retry and error translation policies.

rules.title: Request lifecycle is traceable
rules.rule: Document request/action flow from input through validation, authorization, business logic, transaction, side effects and response.

rules.title: Failure modes designed first
rules.rule: For every critical flow define timeout, partial failure, duplicate delivery, stale state, dependency outage and recovery behavior.
rules.evidence: Failure-mode table + chaos/fault tests where justified

rules.title: Stateless compute by default
rules.rule: Do not rely on process memory for durable cross-request state; persist durable state in explicit backing services.

rules.title: Background work is explicit
rules.rule: Long-running, retryable or scheduled work MUST have explicit job ownership, idempotency, visibility, retry/dead-letter and reconciliation strategy.

rules.title: Environment config separated from code
rules.rule: Environment-varying configuration and secrets MUST not be hardcoded in source. Configuration schema, defaults and required variables MUST be explicit.
rules.evidence: Config schema + secret scan + startup validation

rules.title: Project-specific architecture decisions recorded
rules.rule: Any deviation from global baseline MUST be captured as a decision with rationale, trade-offs and revisit trigger.

rules.title: Architecture follows real repository
rules.rule: AI and humans MUST inspect the current repo, schema, deployments and tests before proposing major architecture changes.

rules.title: Change blast radius identified
rules.rule: Before cross-module changes identify affected APIs, data, permissions, caches, jobs, analytics, tests, docs and operational runbooks.

rules.title: Reversible migration path
rules.rule: Risky architecture changes MUST define rollback, roll-forward or compatibility strategy before deployment.
rules.evidence: Migration/release plan + tested rollback where feasible

rules.title: Smallest coherent change batch
rules.rule: Implement the smallest batch that can be independently verified; do not mix unrelated refactors with behavior changes without explicit reason.

rules.title: No hidden critical side effects
rules.rule: Critical side effects MUST be explicit in service flow and observable; avoid implicit hooks that bypass transaction, authorization or audit rules.

rules.title: Architecture freshness checkpoint
rules.rule: Active projects MUST periodically verify architecture docs against code and runtime reality.

rules.title: Semantic HTML first
rules.rule: Use native semantic HTML elements for their intended meaning before adding ARIA or generic div/span interaction patterns.

rules.title: Native controls before custom widgets
rules.rule: Prefer native button, link, input, select, dialog and form behavior unless a custom widget has a documented need and complete keyboard/AT behavior.

rules.title: Explicit button types
rules.rule: Buttons inside forms MUST declare intended type when accidental submit behavior is possible.

rules.title: One source of truth for UI state
rules.rule: Do not duplicate the same authoritative state across URL, global store, local component and server cache without synchronization rules.

rules.title: Server state distinguished from client state
rules.rule: Remote/server state, URL state, ephemeral interaction state and persisted client state MUST have separate ownership semantics.

rules.title: URL represents shareable navigation state
rules.rule: Filters, pagination, selected resources and deep-linkable views SHOULD use stable URLs when users need refresh/share/back-forward behavior.

rules.title: All async states designed
rules.rule: Every async user journey MUST define loading, success, empty, partial, error, retry, offline where relevant and permission-denied states.

rules.title: No false success
rules.rule: UI MUST not display durable success before the trusted write boundary confirms success; optimistic UI requires explicit rollback/reconciliation.

rules.title: Forms preserve user work
rules.rule: Validation/server errors SHOULD preserve non-sensitive user input; destructive navigation with unsaved work requires deliberate handling.

rules.title: Errors actionable and associated
rules.rule: Validation errors MUST identify the problem, associate with affected controls and provide recovery guidance without relying only on color.

rules.title: Responsive by content not device names
rules.rule: Design layouts for content constraints and tested viewport ranges; do not assume fixed device classes.

rules.title: Touch targets and focus visibility
rules.rule: Interactive targets and focus indicators MUST satisfy the project accessibility target; never remove focus outline without an accessible replacement.

rules.title: Stable layout dimensions
rules.rule: Reserve space for images, embeds, ads and async content when dimensions can be known to prevent layout shifts.

rules.title: Component API over copy-paste
rules.rule: Repeated stable UI behavior SHOULD become shared primitives; domain-specific behavior stays near the feature.

rules.title: No giant god components
rules.rule: Split components when they combine unrelated data fetching, business decisions, rendering, mutation and orchestration.

rules.title: Client boundary minimized
rules.rule: Do not move code to the browser merely for convenience; keep secrets and privileged logic server-side and minimize shipped JavaScript.

rules.title: Third-party scripts governed
rules.rule: Every third-party script MUST have owner, purpose, data impact, performance impact, failure behavior and removal path.

rules.title: Progressive enhancement for critical flows
rules.rule: Critical content/actions SHOULD remain understandable and recoverable under slow JS, failed chunks or partial hydration where architecture permits.

rules.title: Validate at trusted boundary
rules.rule: Treat all client and external-provider input as untrusted; validate shape, type, ranges, ownership context and business invariants server-side.

rules.title: Authorization on every protected action
rules.rule: Enforce authorization at trusted server boundaries for each action/resource; hidden UI is never authorization.

rules.title: Business invariants in services/domain
rules.rule: Durable business rules MUST live in reusable server-side use-case/domain boundaries, not only route handlers or UI.

rules.title: Transactions match invariants
rules.rule: Operations that must succeed/fail together MUST share an explicit transaction boundary; external side effects require outbox/saga/reconciliation where atomicity is impossible.

rules.title: Idempotency for retryable commands
rules.rule: Commands exposed to network retry, webhook redelivery, jobs or payment/order creation MUST define idempotency semantics and key scope.

rules.title: Concurrency conflicts deliberate
rules.rule: For contested state define locking, version checks, uniqueness constraints, atomic updates or conflict responses; never assume requests serialize.

rules.title: Timeout every remote call
rules.rule: Remote calls MUST have finite timeouts appropriate to user/job budget; defaults are not accepted blindly.

rules.title: Retries bounded and selective
rules.rule: Retry only failures likely to be transient; use bounded attempts, backoff/jitter where appropriate and avoid retrying non-idempotent work without protection.

rules.title: Errors translated by boundary
rules.rule: Infrastructure/provider errors MUST be translated into stable domain/application errors without leaking secrets or vendor internals.

rules.title: No swallowed failures
rules.rule: Do not catch and ignore failures that change correctness; handled failures require explicit fallback, metric/log and user/job outcome.

rules.title: Jobs observable and reconcilable
rules.rule: Jobs MUST expose status, attempts, age, terminal failure and reconciliation path for important work.

rules.title: Schedulers safe under multiple instances
rules.rule: Scheduled tasks MUST define leader/lease/unique job semantics so scale-out does not duplicate unsafe work.

rules.title: Graceful shutdown
rules.rule: Services/workers SHOULD stop accepting new work, finish or safely checkpoint in-flight work and close resources within deployment timeout.

rules.title: Startup validates dependencies/config
rules.rule: Fail fast on invalid required configuration; distinguish optional dependency degradation from impossible startup.

rules.title: Structured audit for high-impact actions
rules.rule: High-impact business/admin/security actions MUST emit durable audit evidence with actor, action, target, time and outcome while avoiding secret leakage.
rules.evidence: Audit event tests and retention policy

rules.title: HTTP method semantics respected
rules.rule: Use HTTP methods according to safety/idempotency semantics; do not hide state-changing behavior behind GET.

rules.title: Status codes represent outcome
rules.rule: Choose status codes by protocol outcome, not frontend convenience; document async, conflict, validation, auth and not-found behavior.

rules.title: Machine-readable error contract
rules.rule: Use one stable error shape. Prefer RFC 9457 problem details where suitable and include machine-readable type/code without leaking sensitive internals.

rules.title: API contract version pinned
rules.rule: Maintain an explicit OpenAPI contract for externally consumed or multi-client APIs; pin version and validate in CI.

rules.title: Request/response schemas explicit
rules.rule: Define schemas for payloads and validate at boundaries; distinguish absent, null and empty semantics.

rules.title: Compatibility policy explicit
rules.rule: Define what is breaking, deprecation window and migration process before independent clients depend on the API.

rules.title: Pagination bounded
rules.rule: Large collections MUST use bounded pagination; define stable order and cursor/offset trade-offs. Never return unbounded datasets by default.

rules.title: Filtering and sorting allowlisted
rules.rule: Expose only supported filter/sort fields and operators; prevent arbitrary query construction from untrusted input.

rules.title: Resource identifiers opaque enough
rules.rule: Do not rely on guess-resistant IDs for authorization; choose identifier shape deliberately and always enforce ownership.

rules.title: Conditional requests used when valuable
rules.rule: For expensive/cacheable resources consider validators such as ETag/Last-Modified and correct conditional semantics.

rules.title: Cacheability explicit
rules.rule: Sensitive and mutable responses MUST have deliberate cache semantics; shared caching requires explicit review.

rules.title: Idempotency contract documented
rules.rule: If an endpoint supports idempotency keys, define key generation, scope, expiration, replay response and conflicting-payload behavior.

rules.title: Rate-limit behavior explicit
rules.rule: Define abuse/resource protection limits and client-visible behavior when limits apply; avoid silently relying on infrastructure defaults.

rules.title: Correlation IDs propagate
rules.rule: Generate/accept safe correlation context and propagate across services/jobs without treating client-provided IDs as trusted identity.

rules.title: Webhooks verify authenticity before parsing trust
rules.rule: Verify provider-defined signature/authenticity using the exact required raw representation and replay protections before treating payload as trusted.
rules.evidence: Real signed fixture tests including modified payload

rules.title: Webhooks acknowledge and process deliberately
rules.rule: Separate receipt from long processing when needed; define deduplication, ordering assumptions, retries, dead-letter and reconciliation.

rules.title: Outbound webhooks safe
rules.rule: Sign outbound events where appropriate, document retries and event IDs, prevent secret leakage and allow consumers to deduplicate.

rules.title: OAuth follows current BCP
rules.rule: OAuth integrations MUST be reviewed against RFC 9700; deprecated/insecure modes are not allowed by convenience.

rules.title: CORS is allowlist not auth
rules.rule: CORS configuration MUST be minimal and explicit; never treat CORS as authorization. Credentials with broad origins are prohibited.

rules.title: API secrets never in URLs
rules.rule: Do not place credentials, bearer tokens or sensitive personal data in URLs/query strings when avoidable because URLs leak to logs/history/referrers.

rules.title: File transfer contracts bounded
rules.rule: Define allowed size, type verification, storage, scanning/quarantine where needed, authorization and content disposition for files.

rules.title: Realtime authentication lifecycle
rules.rule: Long-lived connections MUST define origin/auth checks, expiry, revocation, authorization per subscription/action and backpressure.

rules.title: No undocumented magic fields
rules.rule: Fields with sentinel values, implicit units, polymorphism or special strings MUST be documented and validated.

rules.title: Time and timezone semantics explicit
rules.rule: API timestamps MUST define format, timezone/offset semantics and business-local-date behavior. Store instants and local calendar facts deliberately.

rules.title: Partial update semantics explicit
rules.rule: PATCH/update endpoints MUST define omitted vs null vs clear behavior and concurrency strategy.

rules.title: Database constraints protect invariants
rules.rule: Use NOT NULL, UNIQUE, FK, CHECK or equivalent constraints for invariants the database can enforce; application validation alone is insufficient.

rules.title: Schema changes via migrations
rules.rule: Production schema changes MUST be versioned, reviewable and repeatable; no undocumented manual drift.

rules.title: Migrations designed for live traffic
rules.rule: Assess locks, table rewrites, backfills, dual-read/write compatibility and rollback/roll-forward before large changes.

rules.title: Backfills resumable
rules.rule: Large data migrations SHOULD be chunked, idempotent/resumable and observable with progress and failure recovery.

rules.title: Deletion semantics explicit
rules.rule: Define hard delete, soft delete, retention, restore and referential consequences; never accumulate undeletable personal data by accident.

rules.title: Tenant key on tenant-owned data
rules.rule: Tenant ownership MUST be explicit in schema and enforced in trusted query/policy boundaries; cross-tenant access tests are mandatory.

rules.title: Money uses exact representation
rules.rule: Represent money using exact decimal/minor-unit semantics with explicit currency; binary floating point is not authoritative for monetary totals.

rules.title: Quantities and units explicit
rules.rule: Store units and precision deliberately; conversions must be centralized and tested.

rules.title: Immutable business history where required
rules.rule: For stock movements, payments, audit and ledgers prefer append-only event/movement records with compensating corrections over silent mutation.

rules.title: Derived values declare recomputation
rules.rule: For denormalized/derived fields document source, freshness and rebuild path.

rules.title: Cache never becomes accidental truth
rules.rule: Caches MUST have explicit key, scope, TTL/invalidation and failure behavior; correctness cannot depend on an unowned stale cache.

rules.title: Indexes justified by query patterns
rules.rule: Create indexes from measured/query-plan needs and consider write/storage cost; remove redundant indexes deliberately.

rules.title: Backups are restored in tests
rules.rule: A backup without a tested restore is not accepted as recovery evidence. Define RPO/RTO and regularly perform restore verification.

rules.title: Sensitive fields classified
rules.rule: Classify personal, secret, financial and operationally sensitive fields; define encryption, access, logging and retention behavior.

rules.title: Data export/import validated
rules.rule: Imports MUST validate format, size, authorization and partial-failure semantics; exports MUST enforce scope and avoid formula/content injection risks where relevant.

rules.title: ASVS target declared
rules.rule: Every production web project MUST declare an ASVS verification target. Default is Level 2 for most applications; Level 3 for high-value/high-assurance/high-safety systems.
rules.evidence: Security plan with target and applicability

rules.title: Threat model before sensitive architecture
rules.rule: Identify assets, actors, entry points, trust boundaries, abuse cases and mitigations before implementing high-risk flows.

rules.title: HTTPS only in production
rules.rule: Serve authenticated or sensitive production traffic only over secure transport; redirect/disable insecure access deliberately.

rules.title: HSTS reviewed
rules.rule: Use HSTS after confirming HTTPS readiness, subdomain implications and preload decisions.

rules.title: Secure cookies
rules.rule: Session/security cookies MUST use Secure, HttpOnly where script access is unnecessary, deliberate SameSite, narrow Path/Domain and rotation semantics.

rules.title: Session identifiers unpredictable
rules.rule: Session IDs MUST be generated with secure entropy and never contain sensitive meaning; server-side state/validation must support revocation.

rules.title: Session fixation prevented
rules.rule: Rotate session identifiers on authentication and relevant privilege changes.

rules.title: Logout invalidates trusted session
rules.rule: Logout MUST invalidate/revoke server-side session or token capability as designed, not only remove UI state.

rules.title: Reauthentication for high-risk actions
rules.rule: Require recent/strong authentication for sensitive account, payment, credential or administrative changes according to risk.

rules.title: Passwords stored with approved adaptive hashing
rules.rule: Never encrypt or fast-hash passwords as storage. Use current OWASP-recommended password storage approach and parameters, reviewed for platform.

rules.title: MFA risk policy explicit
rules.rule: Define where MFA is required, recovery behavior and bypass protections; admin/high-value accounts receive stronger treatment.

rules.title: Authorization deny by default
rules.rule: New protected actions/resources MUST be inaccessible until explicit policy allows them.

rules.title: Object-level authorization
rules.rule: Check access to each referenced object on the server; possession of an ID is never authority.

rules.title: Function-level authorization
rules.rule: Check action capability/role server-side for admin and privileged operations.

rules.title: Cross-tenant isolation
rules.rule: Test read, write, search, export, files, jobs, caches and realtime paths for tenant isolation.

rules.title: Output encoding by context
rules.rule: Untrusted data rendered into HTML, attributes, URLs, JS, CSS or templates MUST use context-appropriate safe APIs/encoding.

rules.title: No dangerous HTML without sanitizer policy
rules.rule: Rendering user-controlled HTML requires an allowlist sanitizer, reviewed configuration and tests; bypassing framework escaping is prohibited by default.

rules.title: Parameterized database access
rules.rule: Use parameterized queries or safe ORM binding; never concatenate untrusted input into SQL/NoSQL query code.

rules.title: Command execution isolated
rules.rule: Avoid shell execution with untrusted input. If unavoidable, use fixed executables, argument separation, allowlists and least privilege.

rules.title: SSRF controls on server fetches
rules.rule: Validate destination scheme/host, block internal/link-local/metadata ranges as applicable, control redirects and DNS rebinding risk.

rules.title: CSRF protection matches auth model
rules.rule: State-changing cookie-authenticated requests MUST use an appropriate CSRF defense plus SameSite as defense-in-depth; SameSite alone is not universal proof.

rules.title: CSP planned and tested
rules.rule: Deploy a restrictive CSP appropriate to architecture; prefer nonce/hash-based designs over broad unsafe-inline/eval. Roll out with reporting when needed.

rules.title: Clickjacking defense
rules.rule: Control framing via CSP frame-ancestors and/or compatible policy; embedded use cases must be explicit.

rules.title: Referrer leakage controlled
rules.rule: Set a deliberate referrer policy and avoid sensitive data in URLs.

rules.title: Browser capabilities minimized
rules.rule: Use Permissions Policy to disable unneeded powerful features when supported and relevant.

rules.title: Secrets never committed
rules.rule: Secrets, private keys and live tokens MUST not be committed to source or Brain notes. Use managed secret channels and rotation after exposure.
rules.evidence: Secret scan + incident evidence if exposed

rules.title: Least privilege credentials
rules.rule: Database, cloud, CI and provider credentials MUST have minimum necessary scope, environment separation and ownership.

rules.title: Secret rotation/revocation exists
rules.rule: Define rotation and emergency revocation for critical secrets; test without full system rebuild where feasible.

rules.title: Sensitive data excluded from logs
rules.rule: Do not log passwords, session IDs, bearer tokens, private keys or unnecessary personal data; redact at structured boundaries.

rules.title: Security logs tamper-aware
rules.rule: Protect security/audit logs from unauthorized modification/deletion and record sufficient context for investigation.

rules.title: File uploads treated as hostile
rules.rule: Enforce authorization, size limits, generated storage names, content/type validation, non-executable storage, scanning/quarantine based on risk and safe serving.

rules.title: Path traversal prevented
rules.rule: Never resolve user-controlled paths directly; canonicalize/allowlist and enforce storage root boundaries.

rules.title: Open redirect prevented
rules.rule: Redirect destinations MUST be fixed or allowlisted/validated; never forward arbitrary attacker-controlled URLs.

rules.title: Error responses do not leak internals
rules.rule: Do not expose stack traces, SQL, filesystem paths, secrets or internal topology to untrusted clients.

rules.title: Admin surfaces separately protected
rules.rule: Administrative actions require explicit strong authorization, audit, safer session policy and minimized exposure.

rules.title: Dependency vulnerabilities managed
rules.rule: Continuously inventory dependencies, review vulnerabilities, remove unused packages and patch based on exploitability/risk.

rules.title: Lockfile and reproducible install policy
rules.rule: Commit the appropriate lockfile and use deterministic CI install commands; avoid unreviewed floating dependencies.

rules.title: Build provenance target declared
rules.rule: For important production artifacts declare a supply-chain assurance target and preserve provenance where platform supports it.

rules.title: Untrusted PR secrets isolated
rules.rule: CI for untrusted contributions MUST not expose production secrets or privileged tokens.

rules.title: Security headers tested not assumed
rules.rule: Security headers must be verified in deployed responses, including CDN/proxy behavior, not only app config.

rules.title: OAuth tokens scoped and protected
rules.rule: Use least privilege scopes/audience, secure redirect URI handling and token storage appropriate to client type; follow RFC 9700.

rules.title: Webhook replay protections
rules.rule: Where provider supports timestamp/nonce/event IDs, enforce replay window/dedup semantics after signature verification.

rules.title: Security tests tied to abuse cases
rules.rule: Every critical threat/abuse case must map to a preventive control and verification evidence.

rules.title: Pentest scope follows attack surface
rules.rule: High-risk releases require a documented security test scope covering identity, auth, session, input, business logic, client, API and configuration as applicable.

rules.title: Vulnerability recurrence creates learning
rules.rule: Verified security failures MUST create a failure signature/root-cause lesson and regression test before closure.

rules.title: Accessibility target declared
rules.rule: Declare target. Default for user-facing web is WCAG 2.2 AA unless legal/product requirements demand otherwise.

rules.title: Keyboard complete
rules.rule: All functionality MUST be operable by keyboard without keyboard trap; interaction order must be logical.

rules.title: Visible focus
rules.rule: Keyboard focus MUST be visible and not obscured by sticky content; custom focus styling must meet target.

rules.title: Accessible names
rules.rule: Interactive controls and form inputs MUST have programmatically determinable accessible names.

rules.title: Labels and instructions
rules.rule: Provide labels/instructions for required formats and constraints; placeholders are not the only label.

rules.title: Error identification and recovery
rules.rule: Identify errors in text, associate them with controls, focus/announce appropriately and preserve valid input.

rules.title: Color not sole signal
rules.rule: Do not rely only on color to communicate status, errors, selection or meaning.

rules.title: Contrast verified
rules.rule: Text, UI components and focus indicators MUST meet applicable WCAG contrast criteria.

rules.title: Heading hierarchy meaningful
rules.rule: Use headings for document structure; do not choose heading levels only for visual size.

rules.title: Landmarks meaningful
rules.rule: Use semantic landmarks and avoid redundant/unnamed landmark clutter.

rules.title: Images have correct alternatives
rules.rule: Informative images need meaningful alternatives; decorative images must be ignorable; complex images need equivalent explanation.

rules.title: Media alternatives
rules.rule: Provide captions/transcripts/audio description as required by content and conformance target.

rules.title: Zoom and reflow
rules.rule: Content must remain usable at required zoom/reflow conditions without loss of content/functionality except valid exceptions.

rules.title: Target size reviewed
rules.rule: Interactive target size and spacing MUST meet applicable WCAG 2.2 target-size criteria or documented exceptions.

rules.title: Drag has alternative
rules.rule: Functionality requiring dragging MUST provide a non-drag alternative where WCAG target applies.

rules.title: Authentication not cognitive puzzle only
rules.rule: Authentication must not rely solely on cognitive function tests where WCAG criteria apply; support password managers/paste and alternatives.

rules.title: Dynamic updates announced intentionally
rules.rule: Important async status changes must be perceivable to assistive technology without creating noisy live-region spam.

rules.title: Automated checks never equal conformance
rules.rule: Automated accessibility scans are required where practical but MUST be supplemented by manual keyboard and representative assistive-technology review for critical flows.

rules.title: Field performance target
rules.rule: Track real-user Core Web Vitals where traffic allows. Default good targets: p75 LCP <=2.5s, INP <=200ms, CLS <=0.1, segmented mobile/desktop.
rules.evidence: RUM/CrUX dashboard or documented pre-traffic proxy plan

rules.title: Performance budget declared
rules.rule: Set budgets for JS/CSS, images, fonts, third-party scripts and critical route timings before growth makes them accidental.

rules.title: Measure before optimize
rules.rule: Use field and lab evidence to identify bottlenecks; avoid speculative micro-optimization that adds complexity.

rules.title: LCP resource discoverable
rules.rule: Critical LCP content SHOULD be discoverable early; avoid lazy-loading likely LCP images and prioritize appropriately.

rules.title: Images dimensioned and responsive
rules.rule: Provide intrinsic dimensions/aspect ratio, appropriate formats and responsive sources; avoid serving desktop-sized media to small viewports.

rules.title: Below-fold lazy loading deliberate
rules.rule: Lazy-load offscreen heavy media where beneficial, but never blindly lazy-load critical above-fold/LCP content.

rules.title: JavaScript cost controlled
rules.rule: Minimize shipped/executed JS; split by real boundaries, remove unused dependencies and avoid hydration/client rendering when unnecessary.

rules.title: Long tasks reduced
rules.rule: Break or move expensive main-thread work; measure interactions causing poor INP.

rules.title: Event handlers bounded
rules.rule: Avoid expensive global listeners and repeated synchronous work on high-frequency events; debounce/throttle only with UX-correct semantics.

rules.title: Layout thrash avoided
rules.rule: Avoid forced synchronous layout loops; batch DOM reads/writes where relevant.

rules.title: Fonts budgeted
rules.rule: Limit font families/weights, preload only proven critical fonts and define fallback behavior to reduce blocking and layout shift.

rules.title: Caching based on immutability
rules.rule: Fingerprint immutable assets and cache long; HTML/data cache policy must reflect freshness and invalidation.

rules.title: Compression verified
rules.rule: Use appropriate transfer compression for compressible text responses and verify CDN/proxy behavior.

rules.title: Third-party cost budget
rules.rule: Third-party scripts must justify CPU, network, privacy and failure cost; load strategy should protect critical path.

rules.title: API fan-out controlled
rules.rule: Avoid unbounded N+1 browser/server fan-out; aggregate, batch or parallelize only within dependency budgets.

rules.title: Database performance measured
rules.rule: Critical queries require representative plans/latency evidence; protect against N+1 and missing-index regressions.

rules.title: Performance regression gate
rules.rule: Critical routes MUST have repeatable performance checks and investigate material regression before release.

rules.title: Mobile and constrained conditions tested
rules.rule: Test representative low-end/mobile CPU and network conditions; desktop localhost is not sufficient evidence.

rules.title: SEO applicability explicit
rules.rule: Declare whether pages are intended for public indexing. Auth/private/admin pages should not accidentally enter index.

rules.title: Crawlability intentional
rules.rule: Ensure intended pages are accessible to crawlers and unintended areas are controlled appropriately; robots.txt is not access control.

rules.title: Indexable pages return useful success content
rules.rule: Intended indexable pages should return correct success status and meaningful indexable content; avoid soft-error pages.

rules.title: Canonical URLs deliberate
rules.rule: Define canonicalization for parameters, variants, trailing slash, host and duplicate paths without masking genuinely distinct pages.

rules.title: Titles unique and descriptive
rules.rule: Provide useful, page-specific titles aligned with visible content.

rules.title: Meta descriptions intentional
rules.rule: Provide useful descriptions where valuable; do not mass-duplicate misleading snippets.

rules.title: Structured data matches visible truth
rules.rule: Structured data MUST represent visible page content and follow feature guidelines; never mark up hidden/misleading facts.

rules.title: JSON-LD preferred when suitable
rules.rule: Use a supported structured data format; Google generally recommends JSON-LD when it fits the integration.

rules.title: Sitemaps generated from canonical inventory
rules.rule: Sitemaps should contain canonical indexable URLs and update predictably; do not treat sitemap inclusion as authorization/index guarantee.

rules.title: Internal links crawlable
rules.rule: Important pages need discoverable links with meaningful anchor context; critical navigation should not depend on opaque script-only behavior.

rules.title: Redirect chains minimized
rules.rule: Use permanent/temporary redirects according to intent and avoid unnecessary chains/loops.

rules.title: SEO changes monitored after release
rules.rule: Monitor coverage, crawl errors, structured data and traffic after significant URL/rendering changes.

rules.title: Risk-based test strategy
rules.rule: Map business/security/reliability risks to test layers. Do not chase arbitrary coverage percentage as the only quality signal.

rules.title: Acceptance criteria executable or inspectable
rules.rule: Each task/feature acceptance criterion must map to a deterministic test, command, inspection or runtime evidence.

rules.title: Unit tests for dense invariants
rules.rule: Use unit tests for deterministic domain rules, transformations and edge cases; avoid testing framework internals.

rules.title: Integration tests for real boundaries
rules.rule: Test real persistence/serialization/contracts at boundaries; mocks alone do not prove migrations, SQL or provider adapters.

rules.title: E2E tests for critical journeys
rules.rule: Critical user journeys require browser-level verification across trusted boundaries.

rules.title: Tests resemble user behavior
rules.rule: Prefer user-visible roles, labels and behavior over implementation-detail selectors where chosen tooling supports it.

rules.title: Test isolation
rules.rule: Tests must not depend on execution order or leaked state; fixtures own setup/cleanup.

rules.title: Deterministic time control
rules.rule: Time-dependent logic needs explicit clock control or stable boundary strategy; do not rely on wall-clock sleeps.
rules.evidence: Tests with fake/injected clock where appropriate

rules.title: No arbitrary sleeps in reliable E2E
rules.rule: Wait on observable conditions/events, not fixed delays, except deliberately testing time behavior.

rules.title: Failure-path tests mandatory
rules.rule: Test permission denial, validation failure, dependency failure, timeout, duplicate/retry and partial failure where applicable.

rules.title: Concurrency tests where contested
rules.rule: Run real concurrent operations against contested invariants.

rules.title: Migration tests from supported state
rules.rule: Verify migrations on representative prior schema/data, not only empty database.

rules.title: Contract tests prevent drift
rules.rule: Validate API/provider contracts in CI and test backward compatibility for supported consumers.

rules.title: Accessibility automated plus manual
rules.rule: Combine automated checks with manual keyboard and representative assistive-tech checks for critical journeys.

rules.title: Security test scope explicit
rules.rule: Use ASVS/WSTG applicability to plan security verification; scanners alone are insufficient.

rules.title: Cross-browser matrix declared
rules.rule: Declare supported browsers/devices and run critical journeys accordingly; do not promise untested compatibility.

rules.title: Visual regression selective
rules.rule: Use visual regression for stable high-value surfaces, not as a substitute for semantic assertions.

rules.title: Flaky tests treated as defects
rules.rule: Quarantine only with owner and deadline; repeated reruns must not normalize nondeterminism.

rules.title: Telemetry purpose declared
rules.rule: Instrument to answer user-impact and debugging questions, not to collect everything blindly.

rules.title: Traces metrics logs correlated
rules.rule: Use consistent service/resource identity and correlation so traces, metrics and logs can be joined where architecture needs it.

rules.title: Structured logs
rules.rule: Emit structured logs with stable fields and severity; avoid multiline free-text as the only machine signal.

rules.title: PII and secrets scrubbed
rules.rule: Telemetry must apply data classification/redaction and never leak credentials or unnecessary personal data.

rules.title: Golden signals or equivalent
rules.rule: Monitor user-relevant latency, traffic, errors and saturation or a justified equivalent.

rules.title: Business outcomes observable
rules.rule: Track critical business events/outcomes separately from technical logs: orders created, payments failed, webhook lag, jobs stuck, etc.

rules.title: Trace critical external dependencies
rules.rule: Measure dependency latency/error and propagate context safely when supported.

rules.title: Health endpoints meaningful
rules.rule: Separate liveness/readiness/startup semantics as platform needs; do not report healthy when required dependencies make service unable to serve.

rules.title: Alert on actionability
rules.rule: Pages/urgent alerts should correspond to user impact or imminent SLO threat and have an owner/runbook.

rules.title: No alert without owner
rules.rule: Every production alert has owner, severity, expected action and escalation behavior.

rules.title: Deploy markers correlated
rules.rule: Record deployment/revision markers so regressions can be correlated with change.

rules.title: Observability tested
rules.rule: Verify critical telemetry during pre-release/fault tests; logging code existing is not evidence it reaches the backend.

rules.title: SLIs/SLOs for critical services
rules.rule: Define user-centered indicators and objectives for critical availability/latency/correctness journeys.

rules.title: Error budget influences release risk
rules.rule: When reliability is materially below objective, prioritize reliability work according to agreed policy.

rules.title: Dependency budgets
rules.rule: Define timeout/retry/latency budget per downstream call so total request budget is coherent.

rules.title: Circuit/bulkhead only with evidence
rules.rule: Use resilience patterns where failure mode justifies them; avoid decorative complexity.

rules.title: Load shedding deliberate
rules.rule: Define behavior under overload; protect critical work and fail fast rather than collapse unpredictably.

rules.title: Capacity assumptions documented
rules.rule: Record expected traffic, concurrency, data size and growth assumptions; validate before major launch.

rules.title: Graceful degradation
rules.rule: Optional dependency failures should degrade explicitly rather than corrupt core flow.

rules.title: Disaster recovery tested
rules.rule: Recovery plans for critical data/services require exercises, not documents only.

rules.title: Incident roles and communication
rules.rule: Define incident command, communication and escalation for serious production events.

rules.title: Blameless root-cause learning
rules.rule: Postmortems focus on contributing system conditions, corrective actions and recurrence prevention.

rules.title: Release canary/gradual rollout where risk warrants
rules.rule: Use staged exposure/feature flags/canary when blast radius justifies it and define success/rollback signals.

rules.title: Reconciliation for eventual consistency
rules.rule: Systems with asynchronous/partial state MUST have reconciliation to detect and repair divergence.

rules.title: One codebase and revision identity
rules.rule: Every deployable app MUST be traceable to source revision and environment; deployments are instances of a versioned codebase.

rules.title: CI is repeatable
rules.rule: Build, lint, test and package steps MUST be scriptable and repeatable outside one developer machine.

rules.title: Clean dependency install in CI
rules.rule: CI MUST use lockfile-respecting clean install and fail on unexpected dependency drift.

rules.title: Build artifact immutable
rules.rule: Promote the same built artifact between stages when architecture permits; do not rebuild differently for production without traceability.

rules.title: Environment parity managed
rules.rule: Minimize accidental dev/staging/prod divergence; document unavoidable differences.

rules.title: Configuration validated at deploy/startup
rules.rule: Required configuration MUST be schema-validated and environment-specific missing values must fail safely.

rules.title: Database migration gate
rules.rule: Release plan MUST order schema/app changes compatibly and verify migration status before dependent code.

rules.title: Rollback not assumed
rules.rule: For each release classify rollback safety. Data migrations and external side effects may require roll-forward; document exact recovery path.

rules.title: Feature flags have lifecycle
rules.rule: Flags require owner, default, exposure, kill behavior and removal date/condition; stale flags are debt.

rules.title: Pre-release smoke on deployed artifact
rules.rule: Run critical smoke journeys against the actual deployed candidate/environment, not only local tests.

rules.title: Post-release verification
rules.rule: Verify health, critical journeys, errors, latency and business signals immediately after release.

rules.title: Automatic rollback signals explicit
rules.rule: If automation can rollback, define trusted signals and safeguards against flapping or data corruption.

rules.title: Operational runbook updated
rules.rule: Changes to deployment, dependencies, recovery, jobs or configuration MUST update runbook in same batch.

rules.title: Release evidence retained
rules.rule: Record revision, migrations, commands, tests, known risks, approver/agent and post-release status.

rules.title: Dependency inventory
rules.rule: Maintain machine-readable dependency inventory through lockfiles and platform tooling; know direct and transitive exposure.

rules.title: New dependency review
rules.rule: Before adding a dependency assess necessity, maintenance, license, security posture, size, permissions and alternatives.
rules.evidence: Dependency decision record for material packages

rules.title: Unused dependency removal
rules.rule: Remove dependencies and tools no longer needed to reduce attack and maintenance surface.

rules.title: Package source trusted
rules.rule: Use approved registries/sources; protect against typosquatting and namespace confusion.

rules.title: CI token least privilege
rules.rule: CI/CD tokens MUST have minimum scopes and short-lived credentials where platform supports them.

rules.title: Protected release path
rules.rule: Production release workflows require protected identity/branch/environment controls appropriate to risk.

rules.title: Artifact provenance preserved
rules.rule: Preserve provenance/attestation for important artifacts when platform supports it; verify before promotion for higher-assurance systems.

rules.title: Build isolation target
rules.rule: For higher-risk systems define desired SLSA build level and use hosted/hardened builders accordingly.

rules.title: Secret scanning and rotation response
rules.rule: Scan source/history where feasible and treat committed secrets as compromised until revoked/rotated.

rules.title: Dependency update cadence
rules.rule: Define routine and emergency dependency update paths; avoid permanent pinning to known vulnerable versions.

rules.title: Data processing inventory
rules.rule: Inventory personal/sensitive data, purpose, source, storage, sharing, retention and owner.

rules.title: Data minimization
rules.rule: Collect and retain only data necessary for explicit product/legal purpose; convenience is not enough.

rules.title: Purpose limitation
rules.rule: New use of collected data requires explicit review against original purpose and user expectations.

rules.title: Retention and deletion
rules.rule: Define retention periods/triggers and verifiable deletion/anonymization behavior across primary stores, replicas and vendors.

rules.title: Third-party data sharing inventory
rules.rule: Document which vendors receive data, why, fields, region/contract controls and failure/removal path.

rules.title: Consent/preferences not dark patterns
rules.rule: Where consent/preferences apply, choices must be meaningful, reversible and not deceptively designed.

rules.title: Client storage classified
rules.rule: Do not put secrets or unnecessary personal data in localStorage/IndexedDB/caches; define logout and shared-device behavior.

rules.title: Analytics scope minimized
rules.rule: Collect analytics events/properties with explicit purpose and avoid leaking free-text or identifiers unnecessarily.

rules.title: Privacy impact for new sensitive features
rules.rule: Before shipping new sensitive processing, assess users, harms, data flows, mitigations and residual risk.

rules.title: User data requests operationalized
rules.rule: Where product/legal requirements include access/export/correction/deletion, define identity verification and end-to-end fulfillment.

rules.title: Document language declared
rules.rule: Set correct document/content language metadata so browsers and assistive technologies can process pronunciation and rules.

rules.title: Direction explicit for RTL
rules.rule: Use correct dir semantics at document/component boundaries; do not reverse layouts through ad-hoc CSS only.

rules.title: Strings externalized when localized
rules.rule: User-facing strings requiring localization MUST be separated from code and support interpolation/pluralization safely.

rules.title: Locale-aware formatting
rules.rule: Format dates, numbers, currencies and units using explicit locale/timezone rules; never assume US/English defaults.

rules.title: Identifiers separate from labels
rules.rule: Persist stable language-neutral IDs/codes; localized labels are presentation, not authoritative identifiers.

rules.title: BiDi mixed-content tested
rules.rule: Test Arabic/RTL mixed with Latin text, phone numbers, URLs, SKU/code and user input for bidirectional rendering errors.

rules.title: Layout tolerates expansion
rules.rule: UI must tolerate longer translations and different scripts without clipping or hidden controls.

rules.title: Search/collation semantics deliberate
rules.rule: Define normalization, case/accent/script handling and locale-specific collation where search/sort correctness matters.

rules.title: PWA applicability explicit
rules.rule: Do not add service worker/manifest complexity unless installability, offline, push or caching outcomes justify it.

rules.title: Manifest validated
rules.rule: Manifest metadata, icons, start URL and scope must match intended app behavior and be tested on target platforms.

rules.title: Service worker update strategy
rules.rule: Define activation/update behavior so users do not stay indefinitely on incompatible mixed versions.

rules.title: Offline state explicit
rules.rule: Define which routes/actions work offline, how stale data is labeled and how queued mutations reconcile.

rules.title: Cache namespaces/versioning
rules.rule: Service-worker caches require explicit versioning, eviction and cleanup; never cache sensitive responses by wildcard.

rules.title: Push permission contextual
rules.rule: Request notification permission only with clear user context/value; define unsubscribe and token lifecycle.

rules.title: Push payload privacy
rules.rule: Do not place unnecessary sensitive content in notification payloads or lock-screen text.

rules.title: Install/offline tested on real target
rules.rule: At least one real target-device test is required for installability, launch, update and offline behavior.
